body:
"boost_mode": "mult" is indeed wrong, it was supposed to be working with "boost_mode": "multiply". I will fix this.

As for the boost function, the documentation is wrong. The keyword is "boost_factor" instead of "boost". I will update the documentation accordingly.

Thanks a lot for reporting this!

issue.title: fix naming in function_score

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
```
- "boost" should be "boost_factor"
- "mult" should be "multiply"
```

closes #3872 for master

issue.title: FunctionScore: boost_mode multiply does not exist

repository.name: Elastica
repository.description: Elastica is a PHP client for elasticsearch

issue.body: Due to a bug in 0.90.5 the boost_mode "multiply" is named "mult". See https://github.com/elasticsearch/elasticsearch/issues/3872 for details. A workaround is specifying the boost-mode as string instead of a constant.

issue.title: FunctionScore: individual boost for functions does not exist

repository.name: Elastica
repository.description: Elastica is a PHP client for elasticsearch

issue.body:
The final implementation for function_score does not allow to boost individual function. The parameter should be removed:

https://github.com/ruflin/Elastica/blob/master/lib/Elastica/Query/FunctionScore.php#L58

It has been removed in favor of a "boost_factor" function. See https://github.com/elasticsearch/elasticsearch/issues/3872 for details.
